scripts.check: npm run check:structure && npm run check:contracts && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:native && npm run check:core
scripts.check:native: cargo check --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p fluxa-desktop --offline && npm run check:web
scripts.check:web: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="wasm_js"' cargo check --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -p fluxa-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --offline
scripts.check:core: cargo test --manifest-path core/fluxa-core/Cargo.toml -p fluxa_core -p fluxa_media -p fluxa_plugin_runtime --lib --offline
scripts.check:wasm: cargo check --manifest-path core/fluxa-core/Cargo.toml --offline -p fluxa_core -p fluxa_media --no-default-features --features wasm
